This game took me about a month to build with 5.5

\-100% coded with ai

\-100% ai gen cg and art

\-100% ai gen systems and missions

A Tarkov inspired zombie shooter called Dead extraction

was happy to release the demo on web 

problem is, I can't get any feedback since it was never promoted anywhere

except for my twitter. Hope you guys play my game and give some feedback

heads up: this game have some adult features in it so make sure you play it in safe environment

Demo: [https://bleachmama.itch.io/deadextraction](https://bleachmama.itch.io/deadextraction)
